defects.description: Top green pill element appears to be a floating artifact or incomplete header component with no text
Large vertical gap between the feature list and the CTA button at the bottom of the card
CTA button lacks border radius and visible shadow/depth compared to typical polished UI components

top_fixes: Remove or replace the empty green pill at the top of the card (add a 'Most Popular' label or delete it)
Add rounded corners (border-radius) to the green CTA button to match modern UI standards
Reduce excessive whitespace between the features list and the bottom button

manifest.prompt: Create a pricing card for the 'Pro' plan at $12 per month: the plan name, the price, a list of 4 realistic features, and a 'Choose Pro' button.
